### [Advancements in Statistics for Network and Metric Data](https://www.cmstatistics.org/CFECMStatistics2026/index.php)

<div class="talk-event">Organized session at CFE–CMStatistics 2026</div>
<div class="talk-details">Berlin, Germany · 12–14 December 2026</div>

The session brings together methodological and applied contributions on statistical inference, modelling, and computation for complex structured data, including network-valued, graph-based, and metric-space data.
:::
